verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an AI search platform, but the evidence documents no scheduled, recurring, or autonomously triggered automations. The JavaScript runtime "to build agents and custom business logic" is a developer building block, not a background-automation feature. The mention of data sources following different "update schedule[s]" describes how users organise their data, not a product-run scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
